# Font provenance

These files are self-hosted Latin WOFF2 subsets so the app does not depend on a runtime Google Fonts request.

- **Barlow Condensed**: Google Fonts release `v13`, static Latin subsets for normal 500/600/700/800 and italic 700/800, downloaded from the exact `fonts.gstatic.com` URLs returned by the Google Fonts CSS API. Upstream: <https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/barlowcondensed>. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 in `OFL-Barlow-Condensed.txt`.
- **Inter**: Google Fonts release `v20`, Latin variable WOFF2 (weight axis; CSS exposes 400 through 600 here), downloaded from the exact `fonts.gstatic.com` URL returned by the Google Fonts CSS API. Upstream: <https://github.com/rsms/inter>. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 in `OFL-Inter.txt`.

Downloaded 2026-09-09. The WOFF2 files are unmodified upstream artifacts.
